description:
Changes the title, position, and color of the gadget on a dashboard.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** None.

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The gadget cannot be placed in the selected row. The selected row does not exist on the dashboard."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The dashboard you requested either does not exist or you don't have the required permissions to perform this action."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the gadget or the dashboard is not found.
